Declaration.Code: bool announced = false;
string routeLoaded = "";
uint lastBlacklistLevel = 9999;
DateTime lastHeartbeat = DateTime.MinValue;
DateTime lastProgress = DateTime.Now;
uint lastLevel = 9999;
string knownSmelts = null;
uint MiningCap() { return Me.MapId == 530 ? 375u : Me.MapId == 571 ? 450u : 300u; }
bool NeedTrainer() { return Mining.MaxLevel > 0 && Mining.MaxLevel < MiningCap() && Mining.Level >= Mining.MaxLevel - 25; }
bool BagsFull() { return Me.FreeNormalBagSlots <= 2; }
bool CanGather() { return !NeedTrainer() && !BagsFull() && HasMiningPick(); }
bool GatherBuddyActive() { return SecondaryBot != null && SecondaryBot.Name == "GatherBuddy"; }
bool HasMiningPick() { return Me.BagItems.Any(i => i.IsValid && (i.Entry == 2901 || i.Entry == 9465 || i.Entry == 40772)); }
bool NearForge() { return ObjectManager.GetObjectsOfType<WoWGameObject>().Any(o => o.IsValid && o.SubType == WoWGameObjectType.SpellFocus && o.SpellFocus == WoWSpellFocus.Forge && o.Distance < 10); }

void ConfigureGatherBuddy() { var s = Bots.Gatherbuddy.GatherbuddySettings.Instance; s.GatherMinerals = true; s.GatherHerbs = false; s.GatherChests = false; s.SkinMobs = false; s.VendorWhenFull = false; s.BottingHours = 0f; }

void UpdateBlacklist() { uint[] entries = { 1732, 1733, 1735, 1734, 2040, 2047, 324, 165658, 175404, 181555, 181556, 181569, 181557, 189978, 189979, 189980, 189981, 191133, 195036 }; uint[] reqs = { 65, 75, 125, 155, 175, 205, 230, 230, 255, 275, 325, 350, 375, 350, 375, 400, 425, 450, 450 }; var set = new HashSet<uint>(); for (int n = 0; n < entries.Length; n++) if (Mining.Level < reqs[n]) set.Add(entries[n]); Bots.Gatherbuddy.GatherbuddySettings.Instance.SetBlacklistedEntries(set); lastBlacklistLevel = Mining.Level; }

void StartRoute(string name) { routeLoaded = name; lastProgress = DateTime.Now; Log(System.Drawing.Color.YellowGreen, "Route {0} loaded with {1} hotspots.", name, ProfileManager.CurrentProfile != null && ProfileManager.CurrentProfile.HotspotManager != null ? ProfileManager.CurrentProfile.HotspotManager.Hotspots.Count : 0); }

void Gathering() { if (Mining.Level != lastBlacklistLevel) { UpdateBlacklist(); Log(System.Drawing.Color.Gray, "Mining {0}: blacklist updated.", Mining.Level); } if (Mining.Level != lastLevel) { lastLevel = Mining.Level; lastProgress = DateTime.Now; } if ((DateTime.Now - lastHeartbeat).TotalSeconds >= 120) { lastHeartbeat = DateTime.Now; Log(System.Drawing.Color.Gray, "Mining {0}/{1} on route {2}. Free bag slots {3}. Ore: copper {4}, tin {5}, iron {6}, mithril {7}, thorium {8}, fel iron {9}, adamantite {10}, cobalt {11}, saronite {12}.", Mining.Level, Mining.MaxLevel, routeLoaded, Me.FreeNormalBagSlots, InbagCount(2770), InbagCount(2771), InbagCount(2772), InbagCount(3858), InbagCount(10620), InbagCount(23424), InbagCount(23425), InbagCount(36909), InbagCount(36912)); } if ((DateTime.Now - lastProgress).TotalMinutes >= 30) { Log(System.Drawing.Color.Red, "No mining skill point for 30 minutes on route {0}. Stopping.", routeLoaded); TreeRoot.Stop(); } }

void RefreshSmelts() { Lua.DoString("CastSpellByName(\"Smelting\")"); Thread.Sleep(1500); var r = Lua.GetReturnValues("TradeSkillOnlyShowMakeable(false) SetTradeSkillSubClassFilter(0, 1, 1) SetTradeSkillInvSlotFilter(0, 1, 1) ExpandTradeSkillSubClass(0) local t = {} for i = 1, GetNumTradeSkills() do local link = GetTradeSkillRecipeLink(i) if link then local id = link:match('enchant:(%d+)') if id then table.insert(t, id) end end end CloseTradeSkill() return '|' .. table.concat(t, '|') .. '|'"); knownSmelts = (r != null && r.Count > 0 && r[0] != null) ? r[0] : "||"; Log(System.Drawing.Color.Gray, "Known smelting spells: {0}", knownSmelts); }
bool KnowsSmelt(uint spellId) { if (knownSmelts == null) RefreshSmelts(); return knownSmelts.Contains("|" + spellId + "|"); }

void CastRecipe(uint spellId) { var sp = WoWSpell.FromId((int)spellId); if (sp == null) { Log(System.Drawing.Color.Red, "Spell {0} not found in the spell database.", spellId); return; } if (Me.IsMoving) WoWMovement.MoveStop(); sp.Cast(); }

void EndOfPass() { if ((DateTime.Now - lastHeartbeat).TotalSeconds >= 120) { lastHeartbeat = DateTime.Now; Log(System.Drawing.Color.Gray, "End of pass. Mining {0}/{1}, map {2}, zone {3}, route {4}, bot {5}.", Mining.Level, Mining.MaxLevel, Me.MapId, Me.ZoneId, routeLoaded, SecondaryBot == null ? "none" : SecondaryBot.Name); } if (Mining.Level != lastLevel) { lastLevel = Mining.Level; lastProgress = DateTime.Now; } if ((DateTime.Now - lastProgress).TotalMinutes >= 30) { Log(System.Drawing.Color.Red, "No mining skill point for 30 minutes and no branch matched. Stopping."); TreeRoot.Stop(); } }

WoWPoint TransportPos(uint entry) { var t = ObjectManager.GetObjectsOfType<WoWGameObject>(true, false).FirstOrDefault(o => o.Entry == entry); if (t == null) return WoWPoint.Empty; var m = t.GetWorldMatrix(); return new WoWPoint(m.M41, m.M42, m.M43); }
bool TransportAt(uint entry, double x, double y, double z) { var p = TransportPos(entry); return p != WoWPoint.Empty && p.Distance(new WoWPoint(x, y, z)) < 2; }

void Board(uint entry) { var p = TransportPos(entry); if (p == WoWPoint.Empty) return; Navigator.PlayerMover.MoveTowards(p); StyxWoW.SleepForLagDuration(); if (!Me.IsOnTransport) WoWMovement.Move(Styx.WoWInternals.WoWMovement.MovementDirection.JumpAscend, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(50)); }

void Towards(double x, double y, double z, bool jumpWhileOnTransport) { Navigator.PlayerMover.MoveTowards(new WoWPoint(x, y, z)); StyxWoW.SleepForLagDuration(); if (jumpWhileOnTransport && Me.IsOnTransport) WoWMovement.Move(Styx.WoWInternals.WoWMovement.MovementDirection.JumpAscend, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(50)); }
